description: Direct-expansion CRAC with two compressors and an EC fan; not on the CHW plant, so it keeps cooling when the chillers fail, and high ambient raises its head pressure (review A4). Its variable-speed DX coil holds the supply air at its set point; above the high-pressure ambient limit its compressors lock out.

compressor_failure.description: A compressor fails; the unit runs on its remaining stage.

capacity_fraction.description: Available capacity as a fraction of rated.

filter_choke.description: Filter blocks: the fan moves less air at the same speed.

airflow_fraction.description: Airflow as a fraction of the clean-filter value.

supply_air_sensor.description: Supply-air temperature sensor reads with a bias.

trip.description: Unit trips (fan or control fault) and stops until reset.

name: DX computer-room air conditioner

cop_nominal.description: Coefficient of performance at rated conditions.

high_pressure_ambient_limit.description: Outdoor temperature above which the condenser can no longer hold head pressure and the high-pressure switch trips.

m_air_flow_nominal.description: Design air flow (12 K air-side temperature difference).

v_trip_pu.description: Undervoltage trip: the drive stops below this supply voltage.

air_in.description: Return air from the served room.

air_out.description: Supply air into the served room.
